subject: maths
question:
A trip to a destination is made in the following way:

a) 550 km by train at an average speed of 55 km/h

b) 4500 km by plane at an average speed of 500 km/h

c) 400 km by boat at an average speed of 25 km/h

d) 55 km by auto at an average speed of 35 km/h

What is the average speed for the entire journey?
solution:
**Given:**

Train: 550 km at 55 km/h

Plane: 4500 km at 500 km/h

Boat: 400 km at 25 km/h

Auto: 55 km at 35 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance traveled / Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 550 + 4500 + 400 + 55

Total Distance = 5505 km

Time taken by Train = 550 / 55

Time taken by Train = 10 hours

Time taken by Plane = 4500 / 500

Time taken by Plane = 9 hours

Time taken by Boat = 400 / 25

Time taken by Boat = 16 hours

Time taken by Auto = 55 / 35

Time taken by Auto = (55)/(35) 

Time taken by Auto = (11)/(7) hours

Total Time = 10 + 9 + 16 + (11)/(7) 

Total Time = 35 + (11)/(7) 

Total Time = (245 + 11)/(7) 

Total Time = (256)/(7) 

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

Average Speed = 5505 / (256)/(7) 

 {Average Speed} = (5505 times 7)/(256) 

 {Average Speed} = (38535)/(256) 

Average Speed = 150¹³⁵⁄₂₅₆ km/h

**The average speed for the entire journey is 150¹³⁵⁄₂₅₆ km/h.**
